groups.prompt:
We are generating synthetic memory logs for testing an AI assistant's memory compression.
The assistant serves a homeowner remodeling their kitchen with an assistant that compares quotes, materials and schedules.
An observer agent watches each conversation and writes dated observation lines. Write the filler
observations for one date: May 4, 2026. The dates of the whole log are May 4, 2026, May 7, 2026, May 10, 2026, May 13, 2026, May 17, 2026, May 21, 2026; this is date 1 of 6.


Format rules for every line:
- Start with a priority emoji: 🔴 for facts the user stated about themselves or firm decisions,
  🟡 for task progress, tool calls and assistant actions, 🟢 for minor or passing details.
- Then a 24h time in parentheses, then one sentence, e.g. "🟡 (14:05) Agent compared three quotes and found the cheapest was the local supplier."
- Mix: things the user stated ("User stated ..."), questions the user asked ("User asked ..."),
  assistant actions and tool calls ("Agent searched ...", "Agent ran ..."), and completed work ("✅ ...").
- Use specific but invented details (names, numbers, places) so the log feels real.
- Exactly 14 lines, times ascending, between 07:00 and 22:00. Move the story forward from earlier dates.

The log already contains these lines (written elsewhere). Do NOT repeat, rephrase, contradict, or mention
their subjects, people, numbers, places, or dates at all:
- User stated the general contractor quoted $18,400 for the remodel.
- User stated the revised contractor quote is $21,250.
- User set a rule: always send them photos before any wall is opened up.
- User stated the appliance allowance is $6,300.

Return JSON: {"date": "May 4, 2026", "lines": ["..."]}

lines: 🔴 (07:05) User stated they want a modern island with integrated sink.
🟡 (07:30) Agent searched local suppliers for 36‑inch undermount stainless sinks.
🟢 (08:10) User mentioned they enjoy cooking Italian dishes.
🟡 (09:00) Agent retrieved three sink models and noted prices: $420, $515, $630.
🟡 (09:45) Agent compared the models and highlighted the $515 model for its quiet disposal system.
🟡 (10:20) Agent scheduled a virtual demo of the $515 sink for the user at 2 PM.
🔴 (11:05) User asked whether a matte black faucet would match the island design.
🟡 (12:15) Agent ran a design overlay showing matte black faucet against white quartz.
🟢 (13:30) User noted their pet dog, Bella, will be in the kitchen during renovations.
🟡 (14:55) Agent sent the overlay image to the user and logged the delivery.
🟡 (15:40) User approved the matte black faucet and requested a matching soap dispenser.
🟢 (16:50) Agent recorded the user's preference for a pull‑out spray head.
🟡 (18:05) Agent contacted the plumbing subcontractor, GreenPipe Co., to confirm availability next week.
🔴 (20:20) User set a deadline to finalize all fixture selections by May 10, 2026.
